claim: Annex11 states Basic Real Property Tax is 1.5% of assessed value and the additional Special Education Fund levy is 1% of assessed value. Their arithmetic sum is 2.5% of assessed value; this sum is derived from the two stated rates.

evidence.source_span:
Section 7. Imposition of the Basic Real Property Tax. – There is hereby levied 
an annual ad valorem tax at the rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%) of the assessed 
value of real property, grasslands, buildings, machinery and other improvements affixed 
or attached to real property located in this City.
Section 8. Additional Levy on Real Property for the Special Education Fund 
(SEF) – This is hereby levied a one percent (1%) tax on the assessed value of real 
property which shall be in addition in the basic real property tax. The proceeds thereof 
shall accrue exclusively to the Special Education Fund (SEF
